8I.
Contract Amendment for Total Maximum Daily Load Compliance Reporting Services (Stormwater Management). Contact Person: Environmental Programs Manager Steenblock
Authorize the Public Works Director, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute a contract amendment, and any necessary extensions, with Mikhail Ogawa Engineering, in the amount of $49,500, to provide Total Maximum Daily Load (TMDL) compliance reporting services, for a total contract amount not to exceed $188,650.
2017-02-15 Item 08I Contract Amendment for Total Maximum Daily Load Compliance Reporting Services for Stormwater Management
8J.
Consideration and possible action regarding negotiating a possible lease agreement with North Coast Repertory Theatre ("NORTH COAST") to build a performing arts theatre on Lot 16 at the Encinitas Ranch Town Center, including the possibility of executing an Exclusive Negotiating Agreement ("ENA") and hiring Keyser Marston Associates ("KMA") to assist in the process of negotiations.
The Subcommittee recommends that the Council direct the City Manager, in consultation with the Subcommittee, to do the following: 1) negotiate and execute an ENA in substantial form as contained in Attachment "A" to this report; and 2) hire the services of KMA, advisors in public/private real estate development, to assist in the process of negotiations, at a cost not to exceed twenty-five thousand dollars ($25,000), consistent with an earlier proposal dated June 12, 2015, submitted to the City (regarding the Intrepid Theatre Company) as contained in Attachment "B".
2017-02-15 Item 08J Consideration and Possible Action Regarding Negotiating Possible Lease Agreement with North Coast Repertory Theatre
8K.
Amendment to the Carlsbad Watershed Management Area Cost Sharing Agreement and Professional Services Contract. Contact Person: Environmental Programs Manager Steenblock
Council take the following actions: 1) Authorize the Public Works Director, in cooperation with the City Attorney, to execute an eight (8) agency agreement titled "Amendment to Agreement to Share Cost of Carlsbad Watershed Management Area Monitoring and Assessment Requirements" ("CWMA Agreement") to add technical consulting tasks, at increased cost, to ensure compliance with San Diego Regional Water Quality Control Board Order R9-2013-0001; 2) Authorize the Public Works Director, in cooperation with the City Attorney, to execute a contract amendment with Amec Foster Wheeler Environment & Infrastructure, Inc., in the "not-to-exceed" amount of $573,316 to provide Carlsbad Watershed Management Area (CWMA) monitoring and data assessment; and 3) Adopt Resolution 2017-11, "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas amending the Fiscal Year 2016-17 Budget" authorizing: (1) the appropriation of $80,953 in additional funds from the seven (7) other signatories to the CWA Agreement to the TMDL (storm water) Compliance Program; and (2) authorizing the payment of an additional $4,048 from those signatories to the City of Encinitas, for program and contract support services.
2017-02-15 Item 08K Amendment to the Carlsbad Watershed Management Area Cost Sharing Agreement and Professional Services Contract

That City Council authorizes the City Manager to execute a one-year contract with up to three (3) one-year renewal options between the City of Encinitas and Crystal Hollins dba Encinitas Beach Kids commencing upon the date of its execution by both parties for Independent Contract Services instructing the Cityâ€™s Beach Kids Program.
2017-02-15 Item 08L Encinitas Beach Kids Independent Contractor Agreement

2017-02-15 Item 08M Summary Vacation Located at 802-804 Dewitt Avenue

Contact Person: Principal Planner Langager
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2017-16 (Attachment 1) approving an off-cycle budget appropriation of $64,000 to the Rail Corridor Vision Study (RCVS) component of the CMLS (WC15A) project budget; and 2) Authorize the City Manager to, in consultation with the City Attorney; prepare a contract amendment with Parsons Brinckerhoff to prepare a Grade Separation Study for a pedestrian rail-crossing at or near Verdi Avenue.
2017-02-15 Item 08N Coastal Mobility and Livability Study

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
